name: dsh-plugins
description: Aggregate DSH plugin bundle — one install, five plugins: dsh-memarc (long-term memory + session archive), dsh-session-git (export/import sessions as committed JSON), dsh-session-branches (session fork tree), dsh-goal-auto-resume (re-arm unfinished goals), dsh-model-reasoning (per-model reasoning capability & effort editor). Declares dsh.bundle, so the whole repository installs as a single profile layer: no clone, no build.
